9:16 vertical, classical lotus pond makeup portrait, Jiangnan noblewoman summer water pavilion photoshoot, half-body close-up of an East Asian classical woman. The subject sits by the wooden railing of a water pavilion, body naturally tilted, one elbow resting on the railing with the palm lightly supporting the cheek and chin, the other hand naturally lowered, holding the handle of a cyan tasseled round fan, posture lazy, quiet, natural, and relaxed. Her gaze is slightly turned away, not looking directly at the camera, with a gentle, reserved, and slightly pensive elegant temperament.
The main subject is an adult East Asian woman aged approximately 20-28, with the temperament of a Jiangnan noble family: elegant, moist, agile, and reserved, not sweet or juvenile. She has a graceful, naturally rounded figure, coordinated upper body proportions, and a naturally full bust. The clothing fits the body without being tight or intentionally sexy, and her posture is dignified and soft.
The character has a delicate and soft Jiangnan beauty face, a small and soft oval face, a naturally full forehead, moist temples and mid-face, a delicate and smooth jawline, and a rounded, refined chin. The eyebrows are slender and stretched with soft peaks; bright almond eyes are slightly elongated with a natural lift at the ends, the gaze clear and quiet with reserved affection. The nose bridge is elegant and smooth with a small rounded tip; the lips are naturally full with clear peaks and a visible labial tubercle, slightly parted. The overall features are exquisite, young, and tender, with classical East Asian identification.
The makeup is a 'Lotus Dew Cyan-Pink' style. The base is clear and natural, skin fair and moist but preserving real delicate texture, avoiding excessive smoothing and oiliness. Eye makeup uses light cyan-gray, soft lotus green, and lotus pink gradients; light lotus leaf cyan is added to the outer upper eyelid, with fine pearl shimmer on the eyelid and aegyo-sal; the outer corner is naturally deepened with light gray-brown. The eyeliner is thin and close to the lash line, naturally extended. Lashes are distinct and naturally curled. A clear lotus pink blush is used under the eyes and on the mid-face, soft but clearly visible. Only small amounts of transparent dew-like highlighter are added to the nose bridge, tip, and mid-face. Lip makeup uses soft pink and light lotus pink water-light glaze, clear and fresh color with a visible tubercle and a natural watery glass feel. The final look is the elegant and moist Jiangnan noblewoman style.
The hairstyle is black smooth long hair side-swept combined with a high classical cloud bun, naturally fluffy at the top, soft layers at the back, with a strand of long hair falling in front of the shoulder braided into a loose long braid fixed with small green jade beads. A few natural strands at the sides modify the face shape. Accessories include green jade lotus leaf hairpins, light pink lotus flower beads, light gold branches, fine pearl chains, and a few transparent droplets—exquisite but not overly stacked. Earring are long tassel earrings made of white pearls and fine silver chains, echoing the water pavilion atmosphere.
The clothing uses a three-layer color scheme of lotus leaf cyan, cream white, and light lotus root pink. The inner layer is a cream-white thin silk top; the middle is a light lotus root pink high-waisted long skirt tied with a light lotus leaf cyan ribbon; the outer layer is a low-saturation lotus leaf cyan translucent short coat (beizi) and wide-sleeved light gauze robe, with delicate lotus, leaf, and vine embroidery, incorporating minimal light gold thread and pearl details. Fabrics are light, soft, with a delicate silk texture. Green clothing must not reflect onto the skin; the face maintains a neutral warm-white tone.
The scene is set in a summer Jiangnan water pavilion, subject leaning by dark wood carved railings. The background is a mid-summer lotus pond with varied lotus leaves and blooming light pink lotuses. The water surface reflects natural sunlight with soft highlights; distant lotuses and leaves form soft bokeh. Wooden pillars and lattices serve as framing; the background is rich but doesn't distract from the face. A light cyan-white porcelain tea cup and a round fan with lotus patterns can be placed near the railing to add a sense of daily life.
The lighting is bright, soft summer natural light angled from outside, with soft frontal-side light on the face, clear natural catchlights in the eyes, and delicate highlights on the nose, mid-face, and collarbone. Water reflections provide subtle fill light, but green reflections on the face are prohibited. The overall image is bright, clear, and soft, not gray, without a uniform green filter.
Photography uses an 85mm medium-telephoto lens, slightly high-angle view, half-body close-up. Face and eyes are precisely focused, with eyelashes, eyeshadow, blush, lips, skin texture, and hair accessory details clearly visible. The background lotus pond is softly blurred. Authentic photography texture, high-end classical noblewoman portrait, summer Jiangnan atmosphere, light and natural, high completion, moist without being overly sweet.
